habitat: Relationship-humor captions and jealousy jokes, largely retired from active production.
diet: Feeds on the gap between an exaggerated stare and an ordinary sentence of dialogue.
predators: None. Self-produced work has no third-party rights holder to enforce against a licensee, which is unusually clean for this genre.
transmission: Video still, occasionally paired with looping excerpts of the original clip.
cause_of_death: Natural decline as reaction-format humor moved to shorter, GIF-native formats.
resurrection: Occasional creator-driven reposts; the subject remains active and could revive it herself at any time.
mutation: Low. The clip is treated as a fixed unit rather than redrawn or recomposited.
prognosis: The cleanest chain of title of any identifiable-person specimen in the collection. Still never pursue for merch without her direct involvement.
enforcement_history: No litigation found. Subject sold an NFT in 2021.
curatorial_note: Self-produced, so the subject is also the author. Cleanest chain of title of any identifiable-person meme here, and therefore the easiest to licence if you ever wanted to.
